claims.text: **ANN（近似最近邻，approximate nearest neighbor）** 通过少访问部分向量或压缩表示降低搜索开销，可能带来召回损失；具体速度、内存和召回取决于索引类型、参数、硬件与数据分布。[Faiss 索引选择指南](https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss/wiki/guidelines-to-choose-an-index)同时介绍精确 Flat 基线与 HNSW/IVF 等近似索引。不要把“十万条”当作通用切换阈值：先用精确搜索做基线，再在目标硬件和真实数据上测延迟、内存与 recall@k。

claims.text: **RRF（倒数排名融合，reciprocal rank fusion）**：忽略各路原始分值，按 `Σ 1/(k₀ + rank)` 汇总候选排名。[原始 RRF 论文](https://cormack.uwaterloo.ca/cormacksigir09-rrf.pdf)在 pilot 中固定 `k₀=60`，这不是普遍最优值；将它作为简单基线，并按目标数据比较不同 k 与分数融合。RRF 不需要跨路分数校准，但仍受各路排序质量、候选深度和截断影响。
claims.applicability: Original SIGIR 2009 paper reviewed 2026-10-21; k=60 was used in its pilot and should not be generalized as a universal optimum. This source does not establish hybrid retrieval quality on this course’s historical corpus.

claims.text: 对每题一个金标，可用 `hit@k` / `success@k` 表示前 k 是否命中，数值与该题 `recall@k` 相同。多金标题用 `|retrieved ∩ gold| / |gold|` 计算每题 recall，再按预先选定的宏/微平均聚合。对标准 precision/recall 定义可参阅 [Stanford《Introduction to Information Retrieval》评测章节](https://nlp.stanford.edu/IR-book/html/htmledition/evaluation-of-unranked-retrieval-sets-1.html)。MRR 用首个相关结果的位置；它不替代多证据召回或分级相关性指标。
claims.applicability: Stanford IR evaluation chapter reviewed 2026-10-21; supports standard precision/recall terminology and definitions. The lesson’s single-gold hit@k equality is a mathematical consequence under its stated setup; the source does not validate historical retrieval outcomes or determine task-specific metric priorities.

claims.text: 在 LangChain `0.3.7` / `langchain-core 0.3.63` 中，`@tool` 默认根据函数签名推断参数 schema；`parse_docstring` 默认关闭。普通 `str` 参数生成 `type: string`，不会因为文档字符串里写了「只支持明天或后天」就自动生成 enum。`Literal["明天", "后天"]` 则能在该版本的本地 schema 中表达枚举。参数说明解析与 schema 约束是两件事；即使打开 docstring 解析，说明文本也不能代替类型约束。
claims.applicability: Pinned LangChain 0.3.7 / langchain-core 0.3.63 / Pydantic 2.9.2 schema construction only. The example does not establish provider schema acceptance, model compliance, behavior in other releases, or tool authorization and side-effect safety.

claims.text: 框架对模型请求和工具副作用的重试可能是不同机制。比如 [OpenAI Agents SDK 的模型文档](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/models/) 将 runner 管理的模型重试设为 opt-in，并在策略上下文中提供 replay-safety 信息；这不能推出所有 SDK 的默认行为，也不意味着框架会替应用保证工具操作幂等。选型时应分别检查 provider 请求重试、工具执行重试和业务操作重放。
claims.applicability: The cited OpenAI Agents SDK model retry policy is version-sensitive and applies to runner-managed model requests. It does not imply tool operations are retried or prove application-side replay safety.

claims.text: 这组原则的代表材料是 HumanLayer 作者维护的「12-Factor Agents」。它试图回答：怎样用软件工程方法把 LLM 功能做成可维护的产品。作者明确说这些想法不等于批评框架，并提出可以把小而模块化的 agent 概念融入现有产品。读者应把它当作**审查问题清单**，再按具体需求决定自行实现、采用框架或混合使用。
claims.applicability: Summary of the 12-Factor Agents authors’ stated position; use as a design checklist, not comparative proof. The repository may evolve; specific framework behavior requires versioned evidence.

claims.text: 官方产品自己的选型说明也会保留多条路径。例如 [OpenAI Agents SDK 官方文档](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/)把“直接调用 Responses API、由应用控制 loop/tool dispatch/state”与“让 SDK runtime 管理 turns、tools、guardrails、handoffs 或 sessions”分别列为适用方向，并说明两种方式可以在一个应用中并用。这只能说明该产品提供这些路径；其它 SDK/provider 的能力与责任仍须按目标版本和配置验证。
claims.applicability: OpenAI’s own guidance for choosing between its Agents SDK and direct Responses API paths; not a cross-provider or cross-framework ranking. Verify current version and configuration.

claims.text: 先选择一个**满足质量、安全、延迟和可运维要求的最简单候选**，记录基线；只有当目标任务的证据表明不足时，再增加模型路由、重规划或反思。
claims.applicability: A bounded curriculum-level paraphrase of Anthropic’s 2024-12-19 recommendation to use the simplest solution that meets requirements and add complexity only when needed; not an API contract, universal cost ordering, or provider comparison.

claims.text: ReAct 原论文描述的是推理轨迹和行动提议交替
claims.applicability: The original ReAct paper describes interleaving generated reasoning traces and task-specific action proposals; it does not assign host authorization or side-effect execution to the model.

claims.text: 将任务反馈转成语言化反思，保存在 episodic memory，供后续尝试使用
claims.applicability: The Reflexion paper describes linguistic feedback from task signals stored in an episodic memory buffer for later trials; it does not make every same-answer self-critique equivalent to independent verification.

claims.applicability: The ToT paper studies search over coherent intermediate thought units with evaluation/selection; this supports a search-strategy distinction, not a production agent orchestration guarantee.

claims.text: LangGraph 的 [条件边 API](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langgraph/graph/state/StateGraph/add_conditional_edges) 就是图状态上的条件路由 API；因此“DAG 无法表达分支”是错误的。一个依赖图可以无环，同时让路由函数按状态选择下一节点。
claims.applicability: LangGraph StateGraph conditional-edge API supports routing to destinations based on graph state; this verifies the framework-specific API shape, not a comparative claim about Plan-Execute cost or quality.

claims.text: 原论文讨论让语言模型根据环境反馈形成文字化反思，并用于后续尝试
claims.applicability: The Reflexion paper describes language-based feedback from environmental signals being used in later trials; this does not guarantee reflection correctness.

claims.text: 强调针对完整任务轨迹和成功条件设计评测
claims.applicability: A bounded summary of Anthropic’s agent evaluation article; supports evaluating task trajectories and explicit success criteria, not a comparative Reflection performance claim.

claims.text: `USING` 和 `WITH CHECK` 不能混为一谈：前者限制现有行能否被看见或作为更新/删除目标，后者检查插入或更新后将要写入的新行。
claims.applicability: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE POLICY semantics: USING scopes existing rows, while WITH CHECK validates proposed inserted/updated rows; this is not a claim that the illustrative policy was executed.

claims.text: Anthropic 当前文档还记录了 `end_turn` 携带空 `content` 的情况；因此不能只看 stop reason 就交付结果，要检查是否存在可展示文本，并由业务闸门判断是否满足任务要求。
claims.applicability: Anthropic Messages API documents empty content with end_turn in some responses. This establishes a provider-specific response edge case, not model task-success semantics for every provider.

claims.text: `tool_result.is_error=true` 表示工具结果被标记为错误；它本身不证明副作用一定没有发生。
claims.applicability: Anthropic documents the flag as marking tool execution errors. The limit about external commit state is an application-level inference; outcome certainty depends on the downstream operation contract.

claims.text: 两个文件都创建在脚本自己的临时目录中，运行结束自动清理，不会覆盖当前目录里同名文件。
claims.applicability: The lesson script assigns both paths from TemporaryDirectory; the collision regression fixture confirms caller files with the former names are preserved.

claims.text: 同一 key、同一参数才可返回首次结果；同一 key 携带不同参数应明确冲突，不能静默当作成功。
claims.applicability: This is an inferred safety invariant demonstrated by the executable local fixture; it is not evidence of concurrent safety or any production receiver contract.

claims.text: 不是同一回事。max_tokens 是本次生成的上限；如果响应以 max_tokens 结束，输出可能不完整，但不能仅凭这个 stop reason 断言 JSON 一定无效，也不能假设每次都会返回半截字符串。应检查 stop_reason，并对实际文本执行解析和业务校验；若结果不完整，再按策略重试、续写或降级。

claims.text: 调用方应从自己构造的 request 确定 `cache_requested`，不能从两个 usage 字段反推请求是否启用了缓存。

claims.applicability: Applies to the lesson's Python teaching helper and discrete count fields; other languages have different Boolean/integer type relationships. Does not establish production scheduler behavior.

claims.text: Anthropic 当前缓存文档说明，**改变 `output_config.effort` 会使 message cache 失效**；改变顶层 effort 时，tool/system cache 是否同时失效取决于模型。显式设置为模型默认值等同于省略，不会造成失效；支持 per-message effort 的模型可通过 `messages` 中的 system message 改变轮次 effort 并保留缓存前缀，但这项能力仍是 beta，需逐模型、逐平台核实。
claims.applicability: Anthropic prompt caching and effort docs checked 2026-10-22; per-message support is model/platform/beta scoped and is not generalized to compatible endpoints.

claims.text: Python 文档将 bool 定义为 int 的子类型，因此 isinstance(True, int) 为真。计数数据若要求整数，应同时排除 bool；否则 True/False 会悄悄作为 1/0 参与汇总。
claims.applicability: Python bool is a subtype of int; the constructed rate example rejects bool values to preserve integer count semantics.
